verdict.rationale: Point-in-time recovery is a fair question for a database, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is a pricing-page line about exporting backups to your own cloud account. That suggests a backup facility, but it does not show restore to an arbitrary point in time, branching, or a defined retention window. missing for 10: documented point-in-time restore to any timestamp, database branching/cloning, retention-window semantics, restore workflow docs, hands-on corroboration of recovery from bad writes.
